description: Metadata checked with `satisfies` against a type literal, which ends in `})` in column zero, so the pattern reads the decorator. `unwrapExpression` takes off an `as` and parentheses and no `satisfies`, so ngc finds no object literal and refuses the component (NG1001, measured through ngc in partial mode and the linker for `check-parts`). The gate read `./widget.html` off the text and passed a component no build compiles; it reads the metadata as ngc does now, and there is no object to read it off.
